searchText.en: Pro4Chem Specialty Resins | Hybrid Resin Technologies Series 3000 VeloXyl hybrid resin launch, waterborne migration, AI-enabled R&D, and specialty resin portfolio. Adaptation and Innovation by Design Pro4Chem Specialty Resins turns legacy coating limitations into modern hybrid polymer systems, led by the Series 3000 VeloXyl launch. Series 3000 Launch Platform Lanzamiento Series 3000 Series 3000 VeloXyl is the primary commercial launch, led by FerraXyl FX-3127 as a next-generation self-crosslinking hybrid resin for premium 1K/2K coatings, alongside XeloXyl and LuXyl for lacquer-speed and exterior-finish performance. Series 3000 VeloXyl es el lanzamiento comercial principal, liderado por FerraXyl FX-3127 como resina híbrida auto-reticulante de nueva generación para recubrimientos 1K/2K premium, junto con XeloXyl y LuXyl para velocidad de laca y desempeño exterior. Total Cost Advantage Ventaja de costo total The TCA model frames 25-70% application cost index reduction when multi-pass coating stacks are replaced with hybrid Series 3000 systems. El modelo TCA presenta una reducción de 25-70% en el índice de costo de aplicación al reemplazar sistemas multicapa con Series 3000.
